The four repaired cases had the note "No allergy history was recorded." Keeping the status fixed a failure that was seen in the unchanged regression suite. For the 108 cases a lexical baseline had warning precision of 43 out of 85 (50.6 %) and recall of 43 out of 72 (59.7 %). Extraction and intended‑facts checks each had precision and recall of 72 out of 72. The lexical comparator does not pay attention to negation or medication timing; its lower score does not prove that an LLM is better. The tests gave all label passages and a fixed proposal. Did not use LLM extraction, live retrieval, treatment generation or independent prescribing‑safety validation.

On the ten development probes the median retrieval‑only latency went up from 40.8 milliseconds to 688.4 milliseconds after reranking; the 95th percentile rose from 204.1 milliseconds to 1,098.8 milliseconds. These exploratory measurements show the tradeoff in this set of data. We omitted end‑to‑end timings because the evaluation wrapper mixed request pacing and transport recovery waits with analysis time.

This prototype separates candidate retrieval from source integrity checks. Keeps missing allergy information inside a limited medication‑rule scope. Development checks recorded repaired retrieval, output processing and extraction behavior. Development checks did not show that the graph improves agreement with the answer key or that real citations give clinical support. The next evaluation must try supported decisions, as well as wrong support and abstention on cases that were written by others and reviewed by clinicians. Until those results come the system should be called a development prototype.

Implementation code, evaluation scripts, source manifests and overall development results were kept with the checked‑out implementation checkpoint [16]. Raw exam text, source books, database backups, credentials and detailed local runs are not in Git. Source and model hashes record the configuration. Public access, to the release has not yet been checked. The study used public exam vignettes and developer‑made synthetic cases; no patient records were used. Independent clinical review and a fresh held‑out clinical evaluation are still pending.
